notes: West bank of the Bishnumati between Dallu and Kalimati: dense RCC blocks of about four storeys, so the tile is zoned suburb rather than old-core. The east strip (x >= 740 m) is the older Kankeshwori side and keeps brick style. Sheds under 22 m2 are one storey, small houses under 40 m2 two. Schools and offices are institutional; shrines are brick with pitched roofs.
